reason: The plugin primarily orchestrates delegated subagent calls by classifying task complexity and selecting configured Flash or Pro models, with manual overrides, session modes, and a routing ledger.

summaries.zh: 根据任务复杂度为 DeepSeek Harness 的子代理调用选择配置好的 Flash 或 Pro 模型，并提供手动覆盖和分派记录。
summaries.en: Routes DeepSeek Harness subagent calls to configured Flash or Pro models based on task complexity, with manual overrides and a decision ledger.

capabilities: Classifies delegated subagent tasks and routes them to configured Flash or Pro models
Supports per-call provider/model overrides and session-level delegate modes
Stores configurable routing rules and model settings in a local configuration file
Displays routing decisions in a session ledger panel
Can measure savings from local session logs using the included script
